title: Russia Raises Authorized Troop Strength to 1.55 Million
detail: Russia has raised its authorized troop strength to 1.55 million, as President Zelensky publicly accused the Kremlin of conducting a mass mobilization. The increase signals Russia's continued expansion of its military capacity for the ongoing war in Ukraine.

media.caption: Russia raises authorized troop strength to 1.55 million amid Zelensky's mass mobilization accusations

title: Ukraine and South Korea at Diplomatic Odds Over North Korea's War Role
detail: Despite sharing strategic concerns about North Korea's growing military role in the Ukraine war, Kyiv and Seoul are experiencing a diplomatic rift over how to coordinate their responses and communicate publicly. Both countries are alarmed by Pyongyang's deepening military support for Russia, but differences in diplomatic approach and public messaging have created friction between the two partners.

title: NATO Issues Formal Response to Putin Nuclear Threat Against Alliance Members
detail: NATO issued a formal response to Russian President Putin's nuclear weapon threat directed at alliance member nations, amid rising tensions in the Baltic region. The alliance's statement underscored collective defense commitments under Article 5 and warned of severe consequences for any nuclear escalation, as the Baltic states face heightened pressure from Russian military posturing.
